name: appshot.gallery
summary: Gallery of 850 curated App Store screenshots and app icons for ASO and mobile UI inspiration.
description: appshot.gallery collects App Store screenshots to inspire App Store Optimization (ASO) and mobile UI design. Browse by genre (Business, Games, Health & Fitness, Finance), tone of voice (Bold, Friendly, Energetic), visual style (3D, Brutalist, Dark Mode, Minimalist, Retro), price tier, and a separate gallery of app icons; each app has its own screenshot page. Aimed at indie developers, designers and marketers.
